title: The Joke's Second Half
youtube_title: The Joke's Second Half | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Dori about a joke whose second half was the real joke. Dori wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
